refund.intro: Khmer Vox TTS sells prepaid digital token packs for Khmer speech generation. Orders can be cancelled before payment approval. After tokens are credited, refund requests are reviewed case by case because the service is digital and usage can begin immediately.
refund.cancellationBody1: A customer may cancel an unpaid pending order from the billing page. If the customer already paid, they should not cancel. They should upload the ABA receipt and contact support with the order ID so admin can match the payment.
refund.cancellationBody2: Approved orders are credited once. Duplicate receipt submissions, fake receipts, and mismatched payment amounts may be rejected.
refund.request.s1: Contact support within 7 calendar days from payment date.
refund.request.s2: Include account email, order ID, payment amount, payment date, and ABA receipt.
refund.request.s3: Admin checks the order, bank notice, usage history, and token transaction.
refund.request.s4: Approved refunds are handled through the original payment channel where possible.
payments.step1.body: Users select Creator, Pro, or a paid token pack, choose quantity, and the site calculates total price and credit amount.
payments.step2.body: The checkout creates a fresh QR for the exact order amount. Users pay from ABA Mobile or another KHQR-supported app.
payments.step3.body: KHQRcc confirms the transaction by webhook or server check. No receipt upload is needed for new orders.
payments.step4.body: The system validates order ID, amount, currency, status, and duplicate protection before crediting the account once.
payments.safety.duplicateProtectionDesc: Approved orders cannot be credited again.
payments.safety.orderStatusDesc: Pending, reported, approved, rejected, expired, and cancelled states are tracked.
payments.safety.adminAuditDesc: Payment orders store approved time, provider response, webhook audit, and credit transaction.
payments.safety.supportFallbackDesc: Users can open a support ticket and contact Telegram if payment confirmation is delayed.

business.f1.body: Business workloads use reference audio for speaker consistency. Normal random-speaker TTS is only for quick tests.

business.f3.body: Business clone rate is only for approved Business plan accounts. It starts at 1.5 tokens per generated audio second.

business.f5.body: Admin can set daily/monthly token limits, max concurrent requests, running jobs, and queued jobs per API key.
privacy.intro: This page explains what Khmer Vox TTS stores for accounts, payments, API usage, and session clone voice generation.
privacy.section1.title: Account Data
privacy.section1.body: We store account email, password hash, token balance records, API key metadata, payment orders, and generation history so users can manage billing and usage.
privacy.section2.title: Generation Data
privacy.section2.body: We store generation metadata such as time, mode, status, input length, short input preview, credits charged, and latency.
privacy.section3.title: Voice Samples
privacy.section3.body: Session clone voice samples are used to generate the requested audio for that request or batch.
privacy.section4.title: Payments
privacy.section4.body: KHQR payment data may include order IDs, payment status, transaction references, amount, currency, optional webhook payloads, and admin notes.
privacy.section5.title: API Security
privacy.section5.body: Raw API keys are shown once when created. The platform stores hashed keys and metadata.
privacy.section6.title: Admin Access
privacy.section6.body: Admins can inspect customers, payment orders, webhook events, API usage, and account status for support, fraud prevention, and operational safety.
terms.intro: Rules for using Khmer Vox TTS, API keys, token packs, and session clone voice.
terms.section1.title: Acceptable Use
terms.section1.body: Use Khmer Vox TTS only for content you have the right to create. Do not use the service for fraud, impersonation, harassment, scams, illegal content, or content that violates another person's rights.
terms.section2.title: Voice Clone Consent
terms.section2.body: You must own or have clear permission to use any voice sample you upload. Voice cloning must not be used to deceive people.
terms.section3.title: API Keys
terms.section3.body: You are responsible for keeping your API keys private. Requests made with your API key consume your tokens.
terms.section4.title: Tokens and Billing
terms.section4.body: Tokens are prepaid usage credits for speech generation. KHQR orders are credited after payment confirmation or admin review.
terms.section5.title: Cancellation and Refunds
terms.section5.body: Pending unpaid orders can be cancelled before approval. After tokens are credited, refunds are reviewed case by case.
terms.section6.title: Service Availability
terms.section6.body: The service depends on GPU workers and upstream model infrastructure. Requests can fail, be rate limited, or be delayed during high load.
terms.section7.title: Account Enforcement
terms.section7.body: Accounts may be suspended when payment abuse, API abuse, clone-voice misuse, or security risk is detected.
